Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Delano for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events across Delano, Loretto and Watertown, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (Santa Stravaganza in Watertown) through December 16 (CPKC Holiday Train in Loretto), with Delano's Old Fashioned Christmas and Harpist Colleen Austin along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Delano

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Delano, including Loretto and Watertown
  • 2 free events, the Watertown Santa Stravaganza and the Loretto CPKC Holiday Train
  • Meet Santa: Santa Stravaganza and Tree Lighting Ceremony in Watertown
  • Trains: the CPKC Holiday Train at the County Road 19 crossing in Loretto on December 16
  • Season: December 5 to 16 (plus the dates of the two events already on the page)

Planning a bigger day out? Delano families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Minneapolis, which covers the Holly Trolley, Christkindl market and the Children's Theatre.
